title: Flip Game II
statement: Given an array of integers, find all unique triplets in the array that sum up to zero. A triplet is a set of three numbers. The solution should return a list of all such triplets. If no such triplets exist, return an empty list. The input array will contain at least three elements and at most 1000 elements. Each element in the array will be between -1000 and 1000. The order of the triplets in the output does not matter.
